name: The Wealth Company Multi Cap Fund - Regular Plan - Growth
exitLoad: 1% - If redeemed/switched out within 180 days from the date of allotment. Nil - if redeemed/switched out after 180 days from the date of allotment
objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to generate long-term capital appreciation by predominantly investing in equity and equity related securities of large cap, mid cap and small cap companies. There is no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved.
